review.notes: Gate FAIL at 55f95f5 (layer-ids=9: 'Layer AG2.x.' headings lack the colon; residue=6: four <a id=> anchors and two 'source packet' phrases), so no acceptance although every finding is P3. Build clean (sorry only); depcheck run with --movable: 209 roadmaps, 1501 edges, 0 problems; out-of-folder diff empty. Seeded sample 'P-ordinary arithmetic block comparison' verified against Hevesi Cor 4.25/Thm 4.27/Lemma 4.28 (arXiv 2311.13514v2 pp.67-69) and AHTW Lemma 5.4.12/Thm 5.4.13/Lemma 5.4.18 (arXiv 2607.11763v1 pp.97-104); 'Bounded boundary comparison and degree shifting' verified against AHTW Def 5.2.4, Assumption 5.2.6, Lemma 5.2.7, Prop 5.2.8, Thm 5.2.9 (pp.74-78) and ACC+ Thm 2.3.7 (author copy p.938); the README's correction of AHTW's printed condition (1) confirmed. hlttFactorSeparation matches HLTT Prop 7.12 (author copy p.227) in its full generality; FiniteModelDecomposedGenericPrime matches ACC+ Def 4.3.1/Lemma 4.3.2 (p.972). #check of all three declarations compared with the README; one-tactic probe (simp, infer_instance, aesop) closes nothing. Supplier section headings resolved for ~45 roadmaps at main or open heads; AG2.6 geometric prefix ownership confirmed against HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas #1252, which imports it. Findings: layer-heading colon, anchors/residue, misnamed supplier declarations and one misnamed ETUTC section plus a nonexistent Mathlib lemma name, Lean namespace TauCeti.AutomorphicGalois, missing Part-II boundary sentence, Checks naming Lean predicates, four AHTW page locators off by one. Source issues: AHTW Prop 5.2.8(1) misprint (≠∅ for =∅); BLGGT §2.1 parity normalization fails for odd w.
